messages.content: Could you provide me with the hourly forecast for temperature, wind speed, and precipitation for the next 10 days at the coordinates 37.8651 N, 119.5383 W?

function.name: fetch_weather_data
function.description: Retrieves weather forecast data for a specific location using the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The API endpoint for fetching weather data. This should be the full URL, including protocol and domain, without parameters.

latitude.description: The latitude of the location for which weather data is to be fetched. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: The longitude of the location for which weather data is to be fetched. This is a float type value.

units.description: The units for temperature and wind speed.

language.description: The language for weather condition texts.

message.reasoning:
We need to call fetch_weather_data with appropriate parameters. The user wants hourly forecast for temperature, wind speed, precipitation for next 10 days at coordinates 37.8651 N, -119.5383 W. We need to specify the URL (default). Latitude 37.8651, longitude -119.5383. Units metric. Language en.

Also we need to request hourly data for temperature_2m, windspeed_10m, precipitation. And also set daily? Actually they want hourly forecast for next 10 days. So we need to set hourly=temperature_2m,windspeed_10m,precipitation. Also set start_date and end_date? The API supports start_date and end_date. For next 10 days from today. Let's compute dates. Today is 2026-07-20. Next 10 days includes 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-29 inclusive? That would be 10 days. But maybe they want next 10 days after today? Usually next 10 days means 10 days ahead. We'll include start_date as today. End_date as today + 9 days? Actually if we include today, that's 10 days. So end_date = 2026-07-29. We'll set timezone=auto or localtime? Not necessary.

So call fetch_weather_data with url default, latitude 37.8651, longitude -119.5383, units metric, language en, hourly=temperature_2m,windspeed_10m,precipitation, start_date=2026-07-20, end_date=2026-07-29.
